turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You have until 4:40, and Owen found out about this zero on his phone in the middle of a class. Nobody called me first. Who decided, and on what basis?
Don't thank me. I asked you who entered that zero, and I'm waiting.
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Then why is there a zero next to his name? Flattery isn't an answer, so show me what you have.
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Spare me. You've had three chances to tell me who decided on that zero, and you haven't taken one.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.

You want my blessing to "handle this my way," and I don't even know what your way was. Your own procedure says a parent is contacted before any mark goes in, and that's 4.2. Tell me what your way is, in plain words, right now.
